hero_title: YouTube on Xbox 360. No PC needed.
hero_description: Your account. Original audio. 720p60 and 1080p. All on Xbox, without Xbox Live.
tv_label: Interactive Tube360 preview. Use arrow keys to select a video, Enter to watch and Escape to go back.
desktop_help: arrow keys, click or a controller
mobile_help: tap a video or use the controls below
down: Select below or open Like / Dislike
disclosure: A hands-on preview of the interface. The app itself runs on your Xbox 360.
how_description: Tube360 connects to YouTube over HTTPS. Your Xbox decodes H.264 video and AAC audio itself, and handles your account, phone pairing and Cast sound.
native: Its own title in Aurora · native .xex
footprint_description: Browse and watch on the console. A PC server is an optional reserve.
server_options: Actual resolution and frame rate adapt to source, network and console load. Native 1080p output requires HDMI and dashboard 1080p progressive.
features_intro_1: Your videos, your account, your controller.
features_intro_2: With a few good reasons to stay on the sofa.
account_description: A TV code connects recommendations, subscriptions, history and resume, Watch later, playlists, likes/dislikes and Music. The token stays only on your console.
search_description: Browse categories and a home grid with three or four videos per row. Search with the on-screen keyboard, all from your controller.
cast_title: Your phone can take the lead
cast_description: Send videos from the official YouTube phone app. The Xbox can send audio directly to Google Nest / Cast speakers; no PC needed. Live currently uses TV sound.
sleep_title: One less thing to switch off
sleep_description: Choose 15 minutes to 2 hours, or end of video. A warning, a volume fade, then the Xbox turns itself off. The timer runs on the console.
account_alt: Tube360 sign-in screen with a code for linking a YouTube account
account_caption: Sign in on the TV. Make yourself at home.
actual_interface: PC capture · console mode · demo account/codes where shown
player_description: Select the Like or Dislike icon below the timeline without leaving the video.
maintenance_description: When YouTube changes something, a signed rule update fixes every console without a new release. Ed25519-verified, with automatic fallback.
language_description: English, Portuguese and Spanish, large text and Xbox One / Series button prompts.
install_intro: Copy the folder. Open the app. Pick a video.
requirements_console: An Xbox 360 that runs unsigned code.
requirements_hacks: BadUpdate, RGH or JTAG. Tested with BadUpdate + XeUnshackle + Aurora.
requirements_software: Correct console date/time for HTTPS. No PC or Xbox Live required.
requirements_other: For phone discovery and Nest, keep devices on the same home network.
step_1_description: Download and extract the ZIP or .7z. Copy the whole Tube360 folder to writable Xbox storage, keeping default.xex and all four fonts together.
step_2_description: Keep default.xex and all four fonts together. Open default.xex from Aurora, FSD or XeXMenu.
step_3_description: Search and watch without signing in. Optionally link your account in Settings with a TV code. Phone pairing uses a separate code in Phone.
star_description: If Tube360 is useful to you, a star on GitHub is the best thank-you.
legal: Tube360 is not affiliated with YouTube, Google or Microsoft. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Xbox 360 is a trademark of Microsoft.
meta_title: Tube360 | YouTube on Xbox 360. No PC needed.
meta_description: YouTube on Xbox 360 without a PC or Xbox Live: your account, 720p60 and 1080p profiles, original audio, live, phone Cast, Nest sound and a native sleep timer.
og_alt: Tube360 website with a playable preview of the Xbox 360 app
copy_error: Select the command and copy it manually.
ip_help: Replace the example IP with your PC’s address. Run this in the extracted app folder, then copy server.txt to the Xbox.
no_js_alt: Tube360 home screen. Enable JavaScript to try the interactive preview.
demo_description: A filmed walkthrough of Tube360 on the TV.
sample_videos: This preview uses the home screen’s sample videos.
player_open: Player preview opened. Enter or A pauses. Down opens Like / Dislike. Escape or B goes back.
preview_rating_note: In this preview only. Your YouTube account is not connected.
refreshed: Home screen refreshed. This is an interface preview.
search_note: Search with the on-screen keyboard in the full app.
autoplay_cancel: Autoplay cancelled. Press B again to go back.
rating_help: Rate this video. Use left or right, then A to select.
sleep_note: Set a sleep timer in the full app.
next_help: Up next in 8 seconds. A watches now. B cancels.
controller_help: Controller connected. Use the D-pad or left stick, A to select and B to go back.
search_caption: A keyboard that works from your sofa.
cast_caption: Pick it on your phone. Watch it on the TV.
sleep_alt: Tube360 sleep timer over the player
sleep_caption: One more video. Then call it a night.
rating_alt: Like icon selected in the current native player
next_description: At the end of a video, an 8-second countdown gives you time to choose: A to watch now, B to cancel.
next_alt_feature: Tube360 next video countdown with thumbnail, title and channel
members_alt: Tube360 notice that a video is only for channel members
hd_description: 720p60 and 1080p profiles, with adaptive quality and frame rate under load.
original_description: Original audio preferred over automatic dubbing. Choose other offered tracks in the player.
live_description: Live streams open near the live edge, with an action to return to it.
network_description: Resume interrupted connections and switch to a lighter quality on weak networks.
why_description: Your old Xbox can be your living-room YouTube player again, with your account and controller in one native app. Free, open source, and built to run without another computer.
account_notice: I use it every day with my Premium account, with no warning so far. It is an unofficial client and things can change; use a secondary account if you prefer.
ai_notice: AI-assisted, reviewed and tested on a real console. Final acceptance of this release build remains with the coordinator.
roadmap_description: Broader Premium account Music · search filters and suggestions · HDD downloads · automatic speaker discovery. Planned for v0.4.
verification: VirusTotal: final scan link and executable SHA-256 pending. Package hashes accompany the release.
badge_alt: Members-only badge on TV Palmeiras videos
gallery_note: PC captures in console mode. Demo comments/counts and membership examples are synthetic; Nest shows configuration only.
comments_description: Scroll comments with the controller. Dislike counts are estimates from Return YouTube Dislike.
comments_alt: Fictional Demo comments in the native player
speed_description: Eight speeds from 0.25× to 2× preserve voice pitch. Repeat the video; the sleep timer still takes priority. Changed speed uses TV sound.
crt_description: 4:3 / 480 with safe margins, large text and fit or fill. 480i/480p follows the Xbox dashboard.
large_description: English, Portuguese and Spanish. Larger text in HD; enabled automatically on SD TVs.
large_alt: HD home screen with large text
fill_description: Keep the full picture with letterboxing, or crop to fill the screen without stretching.
